subtopic: python data analytics and visualisation libraries

leaves.leaf: pandas indexing, MultiIndex, reshaping and combining
leaves.scope: Selecting data by label and by position (loc, iloc, at, xs), building MultiIndexes and working with their levels, reshaping with pivot, pivot_table, melt, stack/unstack, explode and crosstab, and how merge, join and concat behave.
queries: pandas merge how validate indicator suffixes

leaves.leaf: pandas groupby, aggregation and window operations
leaves.scope: GroupBy split-apply-combine (agg, transform, apply, filter, named aggregation, and the observed, dropna and as_index options) plus rolling, expanding and exponentially weighted windows.
queries: GroupBy transform filter apply observed dropna
DataFrame rolling window min_periods center win_type
pandas ewm span halflife alpha adjust

leaves.leaf: pandas I/O readers and writers
leaves.scope: read_csv/to_csv parsing parameters and engines, Excel engines (openpyxl, xlrd, odf, calamine), Parquet, Feather and ORC, SQL through SQLAlchemy, JSON orients, HDF5/PyTables, pickle compression, and the HTML, XML and clipboard readers.

leaves.leaf: pandas time series, date offsets and time zones
leaves.scope: Timestamp, Timedelta, Period and DatetimeIndex, frequency aliases and DateOffset classes, date_range, resample and asfreq, time zone localization, datetime resolution units, and business-day holiday calendars.
queries: pandas offset aliases frequency strings ME QE
Timestamp min max nanosecond resolution unit

leaves.leaf: pandas dtypes, internals and version-to-version changes
leaves.scope: Nullable extension dtypes (Int64, boolean, string) and pd.NA, Categorical, ArrowDtype and PyArrow-backed strings, Copy-on-Write, BlockManager internals, and deprecations and removals in the pandas 1.x, 2.x and 3.0 release notes.

leaves.leaf: pandas options, Styler and plotting accessor
leaves.scope: The display, compute and mode options set through pd.set_option, the Styler API for conditional HTML and LaTeX table formatting, and the DataFrame.plot accessor with its plot kinds, plotting backends and pandas.plotting helpers.

leaves.leaf: NumPy ndarray core, dtypes and ufuncs
leaves.scope: ndarray memory layout and strides, scalar dtypes and type promotion (NEP 50), broadcasting rules, advanced indexing, ufunc methods (reduce, accumulate, outer, at), structured arrays, and the API and ABI changes in NumPy 2.0.
queries: ufunc reduce accumulate outer at methods
structured array dtype fields itemsize alignment

leaves.leaf: NumPy submodules: random, linalg, fft, polynomial and masked arrays
leaves.scope: numpy.random's Generator, BitGenerators (PCG64, Philox, SFC64, MT19937) and SeedSequence, numpy.linalg decompositions, numpy.fft normalization modes, the numpy.polynomial convenience classes, and numpy.ma masked arrays.
queries: numpy random Generator PCG64 SeedSequence spawn
numpy linalg svd eigh lstsq rcond
numpy fft norm ortho forward rfft
numpy polynomial Chebyshev Legendre fit domain window

leaves.leaf: SciPy statistical distributions and hypothesis tests
leaves.scope: scipy.stats continuous and discrete distribution objects and how they are parameterized, hypothesis tests (t-tests, Mann-Whitney U, Kolmogorov-Smirnov, chi-square contingency), resampling methods such as bootstrap and permutation_test, and the newer random-variable infrastructure.
queries: scipy.stats rv_continuous loc scale shape parameters
scipy stats mannwhitneyu alternative method exact

leaves.leaf: SciPy optimization, integration, interpolation, signal and sparse routines
leaves.scope: scipy.optimize (minimize methods, root finding, curve_fit, linprog with HiGHS), scipy.integrate (quad, solve_ivp), scipy.interpolate, scipy.signal filter design, sparse array formats in scipy.sparse, and the spatial data structures in scipy.spatial.
queries: scipy optimize minimize method L-BFGS-B SLSQP
solve_ivp RK45 LSODA Radau rtol atol
scipy signal butter sosfiltfilt filter design
scipy sparse csr_array coo format sparray

leaves.leaf: statsmodels regression, econometrics and time series analysis
leaves.scope: statsmodels OLS, GLM and discrete models through the formula and array APIs, robust covariance estimators, diagnostic tests, ANOVA, and the tsa module (ARIMA, SARIMAX, VAR, ExponentialSmoothing, STL, unit-root tests).
queries: statsmodels GLM family link Binomial Poisson

leaves.leaf: scikit-learn estimators, pipelines and model selection
leaves.scope: The scikit-learn estimator API, preprocessing transformers, Pipeline and ColumnTransformer, cross-validation splitters and hyperparameter search, metrics and scorer strings, set_output and metadata routing, and the library's release history.
queries: scikit-learn release highlights metadata routing set_output

leaves.leaf: Time series forecasting libraries beyond statsmodels
leaves.scope: Dedicated forecasting and time-series feature libraries such as Prophet, sktime, Darts, pmdarima, Nixtla's statsforecast and neuralforecast, and tsfresh, covering their model classes, parameters and APIs.

leaves.leaf: Polars DataFrames, expressions and lazy queries
leaves.scope: Polars expressions and contexts (select, with_columns, group_by, over), LazyFrame query optimization and the streaming engine, Polars data types, and API changes from the 0.x releases through 1.x.
queries: polars expression over window function group_by

leaves.leaf: Apache Arrow, PyArrow and Parquet
leaves.scope: PyArrow arrays, tables, schemas and the type system, pyarrow.compute functions, Parquet read and write options, datasets and partitioning, the IPC and Feather formats, and the Arrow C data interface and PyCapsule interchange.

leaves.leaf: Scaling pandas: Dask, Modin, cuDF, Vaex and pandas API on Spark
leaves.scope: Parallel, distributed, out-of-core and GPU DataFrame libraries that mirror the pandas API: Dask DataFrame and the distributed scheduler, Modin, RAPIDS cuDF and cudf.pandas, Vaex, and the pandas API on Spark (formerly Koalas).
queries: dask distributed scheduler client dashboard workers
pandas API on Spark Koalas pyspark.pandas

leaves.leaf: DuckDB, Ibis and SQL-on-DataFrame engines
leaves.scope: In-process analytical SQL engines and backend-portable DataFrame APIs used from Python: DuckDB's Python relational API and replacement scans, Ibis expressions and backends, DataFusion, the dataframe interchange protocol, and the Narwhals compatibility layer.
queries: duckdb python relational API df arrow
duckdb replacement scan pandas DataFrame query
Narwhals dataframe agnostic API polars pandas

leaves.leaf: xarray labeled multidimensional arrays
leaves.scope: The xarray DataArray and Dataset data model, coordinates and indexes, groupby, resample and rolling, the netCDF and Zarr I/O backends, Dask-backed chunking, and DataTree hierarchies.
queries: xarray Dataset DataArray coords dims attrs

leaves.leaf: Matplotlib Figure, Axes and Artist API
leaves.scope: Matplotlib's object hierarchy and the pyplot interface, layout tools (subplots, GridSpec, subplot_mosaic, constrained and tight layout engines), the transforms framework, the mplot3d and axes_grid1 toolkits, and animation.

leaves.leaf: Matplotlib configuration, styling, text rendering and backends
leaves.scope: rcParams and matplotlibrc, style sheets, colormaps and normalization classes, fonts with mathtext and usetex text rendering, interactive and non-interactive backends, and API changes listed in Matplotlib release notes.
queries: matplotlib colormaps viridis cividis Normalize LogNorm
matplotlib backends Agg TkAgg QtAgg ipympl

leaves.leaf: seaborn statistical visualisation
leaves.scope: seaborn's figure-level and axes-level functions (relplot, displot, catplot), FacetGrid, PairGrid and JointGrid, statistical estimation and error bars, themes, contexts and color palettes, and the seaborn.objects interface.
queries: seaborn displot kde histplot stat element
seaborn errorbar ci sd pi estimator
seaborn objects interface Plot Mark Stat

leaves.leaf: Plotly.py, Plotly Express and graph_objects
leaves.scope: Plotly Express and graph_objects figures, trace types and layout attributes, templates, make_subplots, FigureWidget, and static image export through Kaleido.

leaves.leaf: Bokeh interactive plotting and server
leaves.scope: Bokeh's models, glyphs and ColumnDataSource, layouts, tools and interactions, CustomJS callbacks and widgets, embedding plots, and Bokeh server applications.

leaves.leaf: HoloViz ecosystem: HoloViews, hvPlot, Datashader and Panel
leaves.scope: HoloViews elements, containers and dynamic maps, the .hvplot accessor, Datashader rasterization pipelines for large datasets, Panel apps and widgets, GeoViews, and Param.

leaves.leaf: Altair and Vega-Lite declarative charts
leaves.scope: Altair's declarative grammar of graphics on top of Vega-Lite: Chart and marks, encoding channels and shorthand data types, transforms, selections and parameters, layered and concatenated charts, and renderers and saving.
queries: altair encoding shorthand quantitative nominal ordinal

leaves.leaf: Python dashboard and data app frameworks
leaves.scope: Frameworks for building interactive data apps and dashboards in Python: Dash callbacks and components, Streamlit caching, session state and its rerun model, Voilà, Shiny for Python, and Gradio.
queries: Dash callback Input Output State prevent_initial_call
Shiny for Python reactive render ui

leaves.leaf: Geospatial analysis and mapping libraries
leaves.scope: GeoPandas GeoDataFrames, CRS handling and spatial joins, Shapely geometry operations, pyogrio and Fiona I/O, rasterio, Cartopy map projections, and web maps with Folium and ipyleaflet.

leaves.leaf: Jupyter, IPython and notebook tooling
leaves.scope: IPython shell features and magics, Jupyter kernels and the messaging protocol, the nbformat notebook format, JupyterLab and Notebook 7, ipywidgets, nbconvert and papermill, and the rich display protocol.

leaves.leaf: 3D and GPU-accelerated scientific visualisation
leaves.scope: Python libraries for 3D, volumetric, mesh and GPU-accelerated scientific visualisation, including VTK's Python bindings, PyVista, Mayavi, VisPy, napari and K3D.

leaves.leaf: Network analysis and graph visualisation libraries
leaves.scope: NetworkX graph classes, algorithms (shortest paths, centrality, community detection), graph I/O formats and drawing, plus the alternatives python-igraph, graph-tool and pyvis.
